resources.string: ✓ Tecla is enabled. Tap “Switch keyboard” to use it.
Step 1: enable Tecla in your keyboard settings.

• Corners: small symbols in a key's corner are used by swiping from the key toward that corner.
• Numbers and symbols: 1–0 are in the top-right corners of q–p; the other symbols are in the letters' other corners. Esc is under q and Tab above a.
• Hold a letter, number or symbol to keep typing it until you let go.
• Accents: swipe to the accent under a s d f g h l (or above u), then type the letter. ´ then e gives é. Space types the accent itself; delete cancels it.
• Space bar: slide left or right, or long-press it, to move the cursor like arrow keys. Drag up and down for lines. While moving, tap with a second finger to start or stop selecting text.
• Delete: tap to delete a letter. Hold to repeat; it speeds up the longer you hold.
• Delete, swipe to the top-left / top-right corner: delete a word backwards / forwards. Keep holding to repeat.
• Delete, swipe to the bottom-right corner: delete a letter forwards. Keep holding to repeat.
• Delete, swipe to the bottom-left corner: delete back to the start of the line.
• Shift: tap once for one capital, twice for caps lock, three times to turn it off. Hold shift while typing for capitals.
• Ctrl: tap it, then press a key (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V, Ctrl+Z…).
• Fn: tap for F1–F12, Esc, Tab, Home/End, Page Up/Down and arrows. Hold to pick a keyboard. Swipe to its corners for Alt (top-left), the keyboard picker (top-right), emoji (bottom-left) and settings (bottom-right).
